messages:
Lena (AE): New POC request from Northshore. They want a tightly scoped 10-working-day trial to validate three flows: intent routing, meeting-note summarization, and customer-reply tone polish. Need baseline prompts, eval plan, rough cost, and security callouts by EOD tomorrow. @Omar @Ben @Yara
Omar (SE): Got it. Clarify infra: they prefer hosted but legal may insist on KMS + SSO. Plan for hosted baseline and a Dedicated contingency.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Proposed acceptance criteria: intent accuracy >= 0.76, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.6, tone-acceptance >= 82% on a 200-sample blind audit, p95 latency < 550ms. Also define allowed error modes and escalation path.
Yara (PM): I'll own the runbook and checkpoints. Kickoff next Monday, 10 working days. Midpoint demo on day 6, final review day 10.
Omar (SE): Draft prompt set (compact):
1) intent_v0: "Classify intent: [billing, setup, bug, feedback, other]. Return single token label."
2) summary_v0: "Summarize the meeting notes in 3 bullets with action items first."
3) tone_polish_v0: "Rewrite the reply to be customer-facing, professional, and <140 chars."
4) safety_check_v0: "If content violates policy, return 'BLOCK' and a short tag; otherwise return 'OK' and proceed."
Omar (SE): Each prompt will carry 12 gold examples and an eval metric tag (accuracy/ROUGE/manual_agreement). I'll instrument token counts and response_time in the output.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Eval plan: 200 labeled examples per flow (600 total) would be ideal but we can start with 120 per flow for speed. Example run: `./eval/run.sh --suite northshore_quick --n 120 --model redwood-hosted-std`
Lena (AE): Customer gave usage estimates: avg 1.2 r/s, peak 6 r/s, ~280 tokens per request. Use for pricing sketch.
finance-bot: provisional_cost_estimate: hosted_trial_10d = $X (based on qps and token mix). Dedicated delta = +30-55% depending on reserved GPU size. (placeholder)
Ben (Solutions Eng): Security Qs: they asked about key rotation, data deletion, and audit logs. I'll draft answers; main blocker is if they require control-plane separation, then Dedicated/Private is needed.
Yara (PM): Action list: 1) SEs (Omar/Ben) to upload prompt JSON + gold sets by tomorrow morning. 2) Solutions Eng (Ben) to provide eval scripts + README. 3) AE (Lena) to confirm sample data from customer. 4) Finance (finance-bot) to give a headline cost delta hosted vs dedicated.
Omar (SE): I'll minimize prompt surface area to reduce failure modes and add one confidence field to responses for triage.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Will spin up a canary eval harness in staging and post logs. Command to run locally: `python -m eval.runner --prompts prompts/northshore.json --gold data/northshore_gold.json`
finance-bot: reminder: attach cost assumptions (qps, token sizes, model variant) when sharing numbers.
Lena (AE): If SEs can deliver tomorrow morning I'll present the scope and preliminary costs to the customer on Thursday to lock dates.
Yara (PM): I'll add acceptance checklist to the POC doc and share link here.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Uploading initial artifacts to POC drive now (will paste link).
Omar (SE): Noted. I'll include simple monitoring hooks (per-prompt latency and token histogram) so we can tune batching/quantization if needed.
Lena (AE): Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. Ping here when uploads are ready.
